ZimiGames

Card, board, puzzle and arcade games from around the world, played offline. Your best times and scores stay on this device.

Library

Sky DetectiveName what is in tonight’s real sky Wiki RaceGo from one article to another using links only. Uses your own Wikipedia. Drop PinPin a place on your own offline map TelephoneWrite a clue; your friend finds the article Dictionary BluffFake meanings for real rare words, passed round BabelOne word in five languages: name it in English Where in the WorldTap the map where a place is. The closer you are, the more points. TimelinePut events from your Wikipedia in order First LinesName the book from its first line Letter by LetterGuess the word one letter at a time. Words come from your Wiktionary. JigsawA picture from your Wikipedia. 12 to 100 pieces. QuizzicalQuestions made from your own library FlagsName the country from its flag Higher or LowerCompare places and things from your Wikipedia Spelling BeeWords from seven letters, checked in your Wiktionary Mini CrosswordA small crossword clued by your Wiktionary

Cards

SolitaireKlondike. Draw one or three cards. FreeCellNumbered deals. Almost all can be won. SpiderTwo decks. Build eight runs of one suit. PyramidPairs that add to 13 GolfOne higher or one lower. No wrapping. TriPeaksThree peaks. Wrap around. Keep your streak.
HeartsFour players. Take as few points as you can. SpadesPartners bid on tricks. Spades are trump. Euchre24 cards, trump, first to 10 Gin RummyTwo players. Make sets and runs, then knock. CribbageScore to 121 on a peg board Crazy EightsMatch suit or rank. Eights are wild. DurakBeat the attack. Do not be the last with cards. ScopaThe Italian card game, with an Italian deck Koi-KoiHanafuda flower cards. Make yaku. Call koi-koi. TrucoArgentine bluffing game with envido. Play to 15 or 30. BelotePartners, trump, belote and rebelote SkatThree players. Bid, take the skat, name a game. Teen PattiBlind or seen. Side show and show. Play with chips. BridgeBid, play and defend. Your partner is a computer. Texas Hold’emChips, blinds, all-in and side pots BlackjackGet closer to 21 than the dealer. Split and double. CanastaMeld cards, freeze the pile, play to 5000. Big TwoBeat the last play. Twos are high. Tien LenRuns, pairs in a row and chops

Strategy

ReversiFlip discs. Play Zimi or a friend.
CheckersEnglish draughts. You must capture. International DraughtsFlying kings. Take the most pieces. Men capture backwards.
ChessThe standard game. Six levels. XiangqiChinese chess. There is a river in the middle. ShogiJapanese chess. Captured pieces can be dropped. A small 5x5 board too. JanggiKorean chess. Palaces and cannons. MakrukThai chess. Slower than chess. Chess Puzzles15,000 rated puzzles from Lichess. You get your own rating. Opening Trainer3,800 named openings. Play your side.
GoBoards of 9x9 and 13x13. White gets 6.5 points. Go ProblemsMake a group live, or kill it.
HexLink your two sides. No draws. GomokuFive in a row on a 15x15 board Nine Men's MorrisMake mills. Fly when you have three. Four in a RowDrop discs. Line up four. Dots and BoxesClose boxes and move again. 4 to 7 dots. HnefataflCopenhagen rules. The king runs for a corner.

Family

BackgammonRace home. Optional doubling cube. MancalaOware and Kalah. Sow seeds and capture. LudoRoll a six to start. Race home. Chinese CheckersHop marbles across the star. 2 to 6 players. DominoesDraw and Block games. Play 1 to 3 computers.
MahjongMatch pairs of tiles. Every deal can be cleared. Mahjong for FourHong Kong style, against 3 computers
YachtFive dice, 13 rows. Play alone or against computers. Liar's DiceBid, bluff and call. 2 to 6 players. FleetHide your ships. Find Zimi’s. Royal Game of UrA race game 4,500 years old. Four dice. Snakes and Ladders2 to 4 players CarromFlick the striker, pocket your coins, cover the queen

Puzzles

MinesweeperBeginner to Expert. The first click is always safe. SudokuFour levels. One solution each. 2048Slide and join tiles. One undo. Five LettersGuess the word in six tries. Daily or practice.
NetTurn the tiles until the network joins up NetslideSlide rows and columns to join up the network BridgesJoin the islands with the bridges each number asks for LoopyDraw one loop that uses the right sides of each number PearlDraw a loop through the pearls as shown SlantDraw diagonal lines, each number counting those touching it SignpostLink the squares in order by following the arrows TracksLay a railway from one end to the other UntangleDrag the points until no lines cross PatternUse the row and column clues to reveal a picture MosaicEach number counts the shaded squares around it Light UpPlace lamps to light every square, none lighting another TentsPitch a tent by every tree, with no tents touching MagnetsPlace magnets so every line has the right poles DominosaTile the grid so every number pair is used once MapColour the map in four colours, no neighbours alike KeenFill the grid so each cage makes its number TowersBuild towers; each clue counts those you can see UnequalFill the grid, obeying the greater-than and less-than signs FillingFill in numbers so each region's size matches its number RangeShade squares so each number sees the right count SinglesShade repeated numbers, with no shaded squares touching UnrulyFill with two colours: balanced lines, no three in a row GroupFill a grid so it follows a group table UndeadPlace ghosts, vampires and zombies by what mirrors show GalaxiesSplit the grid into regions that look the same upside down RectanglesDivide the grid into rectangles of the numbered areas PalisadeDraw walls to make regions of the right size Black BoxFire beams in to find the hidden balls FifteenSlide the tiles into order SixteenSlide whole rows and columns to sort the grid TwiddleTurn blocks of tiles to sort the grid CubeRoll a cube over the grid to pick up blue squares InertiaSlide around collecting gems, and avoid the mines PegsJump pegs over pegs until one is left Same GameClear blocks of the same colour FloodFlood the grid with one colour in few moves FlipLight every square by flipping groups of squares
Code BreakerCrack the four-peg code. Pegs have shapes and colours. SokobanPush the crates onto the rings. 300 levels.

Kids

MemoryMatch the pairs. Animals and shapes. EchoRepeat the growing sequence of pads Tic-Tac-ToeAlso noughts and crosses. Easy or perfect Zimi.

Arcade

StackerFit falling pieces into rows. Hold a piece and see where it will land. SnakeEat to grow and go faster. Walls or wrap-around. BricksPaddle and ball. Eight levels. Aim by where the ball lands. PinballOne table with flippers, bumpers, lanes and multiball RocksTurn, thrust and shoot. Rocks split. A saucer shoots back. Last LineDrones move down. Shields wear away. Stop them. LanderLand on the pad before the fuel runs out. PaddlesTable tennis with two paddles. Play Zimi or a friend. CircuitFour tracks, rival cars and a ghost of your best lap Road RushHills, curves and traffic against the clock HopperRun, jump and stomp through six short levels MuncherEat every dot while four chasers follow you CrossingHop across roads and rivers BlastDrop bombs, break blocks and set off chains. Up to 2 players on one keyboard. QuestA small adventure. Find a sword and keys, then beat the boss. ZimiKartEight racers, six tracks. Drift for a boost.
